sinopsis.es: Conteniendo la respiración, la ciudad aguarda la llegada de los «bárbaros». ¿Quiénes son? ¿Y qué se hará si no vienen?
sinopsis.en: In a city - evoking, without specificity, a city of the Roman Empire - the poem depicts a state of waiting: the arrival of the ‘Barbarians’ has been announced. The city holds its breath in anticipation… But who, exactly, are these “Barbarians”? And what if they do not come?
